summary: First test run for GFA Việt Nam site. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (root, quote validation short-name/short-phone, quote creation, background AI classification + email skip, chat SSE stream + Vietnamese reply + history persistence, chat session-id validation). Frontend desktop (1920): hero + 4 CTAs (call/zalo/facebook tel & href verified), all 8 sections present with correct data-testids, 6 services + 6 service-zalo links, 3 fleet cards + 3 fleet-zalo, 4 gallery items with lightbox open/next/close working, 8 client logos, 4 review cards, google-rating-badge, complete footer (hotline/map iframe/2 addresses/zalo/facebook). Quote form: invalid phone '123' correctly shows Vietnamese toast 'Số điện thoại chưa đúng định dạng Việt Nam' and blocks submit; valid phone submits successfully → quote-success + quote-success-zalo + quote-reset all appear. Chat widget: chat-toggle opens chat-panel, message sends, assistant reply renders in Vietnamese (also confirmed via SSE backend test). Mobile (390x844): mobile-action-bar hidden initially, becomes visible after scrolling past 300px, mobile-bar-call & mobile-bar-zalo present, nav-menu-toggle opens nav-mobile-menu with 5 nav-link-* items, chat-toggle sits above mobile-action-bar (bottom 748 vs bar top 771, no overlap). No console/page errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') – consider migrating to lifespan context manager (non-blocking, cosmetic).
process_lead background task performs a lead update even on AI failure; ai_* fields remain None but email_status is still set – acceptable but consider adding a retry for the AI call.
GFA_KNOWLEDGE system prompt is duplicated verbatim per request; fine for now but could be moved to constants module if server.py grows.
test_credentials: None (public marketing site, no auth). EMERGENT_LLM_KEY configured; RESEND_API_KEY intentionally empty (email skipped by design).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test leads in MongoDB `leads` collection with TEST_ prefix names via pytest and quote-form playwright submissions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py at /app/backend/tests/ is pytest-native and covers all critical endpoints. Frontend flows fully validated end-to-end across desktop + mobile viewports. AI lead classification (Claude Sonnet 4.6) working within ~10s. Chat SSE streams properly with Vietnamese output. Note: hero video is 8.7MB; use wait_until='domcontentloaded' rather than 'load' on Playwright navigation.
